summary: Build practical fairness, governance, and reporting skills in 5 days. Strengthen AI accountability and reduce risk with TrainingCred.
lede: Ethical oversight of data-driven and AI-supported decisions involves identifying risks across data and model lifecycles and turning findings into governance actions. This course is for professionals who review, govern, deploy, or oversee such decisions; it develops practical skills in impact assessment, fairness testing, and explainability review. Participants also practice documenting controls and accountability evidence, mapping stakeholders, and planning monitoring and escalation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review, govern, deploy, or oversee data-driven and AI-supported decisions.
prerequisites: Participants should have working familiarity with data-driven decision workflows, basic AI or analytics concepts, and an operational role in governance, compliance, risk, product, legal, or data management. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable reviewing dashboards, policy documents, model summaries, and stakeholder reports. Experience with AI use cases or data governance processes will help you apply the exercises more quickly, especially the fairness testing and accountability mapping activities.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
